downloaded_library.reason: No active local administrator; existing suspended accounts were not modified.

implementation_scope.interface: Existing suggestions and draft-review interface retained. New private assistant chat, voice and streaming are not part of this implementation.
implementation_scope.orchestrator: Task-scoped dialogue state, current-turn intent/evidence contract, bounded regeneration.
implementation_scope.llm: Native conversation roles; local per-touchpoint model selection.
implementation_scope.rag: Current conversation retrieval; approved, current documents scoped by tenant and specialist; public source download/import tooling.
implementation_scope.tools: Existing scoped clinical record, data quality and approved rule tools.
implementation_scope.memory: Existing full case history with per-request state/evidence index; no cross-case memory.
implementation_scope.guardrails_evaluation: Consent, source references, citation validation, service terminology, forms of address, urgency floors, token accounting and specialist approval retained.

limits: No patient data was used in these evaluation requests.
Public documents require specialist review and administrator approval before retrieval.

Local retrieval uses lexical search because embeddings are not configured. Hybrid retrieval support requires a configured multilingual embedding service; production configuration was not changed or verified.
Automated checks do not establish clinical correctness or guarantee every future response.
source_hashes_scope: Implementation at report creation. The 114-case run completed before the final RAG citation-contract clarification; it used no knowledge chunks. The two public-source smokes used the final source citation contract.
